gaps.explanation: seem/appear take the to-infinitive: seems to know.

gaps.sentence: They're planning ___ the flat before selling it.
gaps.explanation: plan + to-infinitive (plan on + -ing also occurs informally): planning to redecorate.
refuse takes the to-infinitive: refused to pay.

gaps.sentence: You should stop ___ so much coffee late at night.
gaps.explanation: stop + -ing = end the activity: stop drinking coffee.

gaps.sentence: She couldn't resist ___ the last biscuit.
He continued ___ as if nothing had happened.
gaps.explanation: continue takes -ing or to-infinitive. Both accepted.

gaps.sentence: We'd better not ___ the neighbours again.
gaps.explanation: had better + bare infinitive (not comes after better): better not disturb.

gaps.sentence: She insisted on ___ for the meal herself.
